question: What should a subscribed Gateway client rely on when session teardown occurs while its outbound WebSocket buffer already exceeds `MAX_BUFFERED_BYTES`?
rationale: The Gateway cannot guarantee delivery through an overloaded socket without accepting forced disconnection, bounded priority buffering, or a reconciliation fallback; that compatibility and availability contract requires owner intent.

options.title: Close and resync
options.body: Define forced close as the overload signal and require clients to reconnect, restore subscriptions, and fetch authoritative session state.

options.title: Bounded priority delivery
options.body: Add a hard-bounded control-event path that prioritizes teardown signals without permitting unbounded memory growth.

options.title: Best effort with fallback
options.body: Keep drain delivery best-effort and retain a documented polling or snapshot reconciliation mechanism.

recommendation.title: Close and resync
recommendation.body: Define forced close as the overload signal and require clients to reconnect, restore subscriptions, and fetch authoritative session state.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current broadcaster and session-change owner boundary whose slow-consumer semantics must be selected or extended.
